lines.quote: designed and implemented the complete digital beamforming subsystem for Aurinko's 16-channel A-800 coherent array, including adaptive null steering and sum/difference monopulse angle estimation
The largest piece of work I have delivered was the A-800 programme, a four-year project covering a 16-channel coherent array with digital beamforming.

Wrote and maintain the core embedded DSP modules in C and C++ for the A-series ground surveillance radar family: pulse compression, Doppler processing, CFAR detection, and track initiation. Code runs on a TI C6748 DSP with a 1 ms PRI budget and SafeC compliance on all safety-critical paths.

Developed the production Python pipeline that generates radar look-up tables (antenna patterns, atmospheric-refraction corrections, range-ambiguity masks) from design parameters. The pipeline is version-controlled with full test coverage and is used by systems engineering for every new customer configuration.

The project included extensive RF characterisation: T/R module gain and phase tracking measured across the 200 MHz operating bandwidth using a Rohde & Schwarz ZVA67 vector network analyser, plus anechoic-chamber far-field pattern verification of the full array.
Directed a team of six DSP engineers across algorithm selection, implementation review, and integration testing against the customer's acceptance criteria.
I was responsible for the signal-processing workstream and directed a team of six engineers from algorithm selection through to final acceptance testing on the customer's site.
Based in Oulu for the entire duration of my employment at Aurinko.
I am already local, available for an interview at short notice, and my notice period at Aurinko is three months.
